close.confirmDescription: Voting will close and the Discord message will show the final result.

repost.uncertain: Tried to repost, check that the bot is online.

delete.confirmDescription: The poll and its Discord message will be removed. This can't be undone.

empty.title: No polls here yet
empty.description: Create a poll from the dashboard or use {command} on Discord.

tags.roles: {count, plural, one {# role can vote} other {# roles can vote}}

dashboard.emptyDescription: Votes and the most voted polls show up here once you create the first one.

noResults.title: No polls found
noResults.description: Try another term or change the filter.

actions.duplicateHint: Creates a new poll using this one as a template

errors.question: Enter the question.
errors.scheduleFuture: The scheduled date must be in the future.

toast.scheduled: Poll scheduled! It will be posted at the set time.
toast.posted: Poll created and posted on Discord!
toast.notPosted: Poll created, but I couldn't post it on Discord. Check that the bot is online and has access to the channel.

form.channelLocked: (a poll that's already posted can't be moved)
form.question: Question
form.editOptionsHint: Editing the text keeps the votes. Removing an option deletes its votes.

mention.label: Ping when posting
mention.editHint: The mention stays visible in the message, but Discord only pings when it's sent (editing the poll doesn't notify again).

schedule.label: Schedule post
schedule.description: Posts automatically at the set time.

voting.title: Voting settings
voting.multiSelectHint: Allows voting for more than one option.
voting.hideResultsHint: Hides the count until the poll ends (avoids the bandwagon effect).
voting.anonymousHint: Doesn't reveal who voted for what (disables the voter list).
voting.showLabelHint: Default: emoji-only button (cleaner). Turn on if the options have no emoji or if you prefer visible text.
voting.compactHint: Hides the colored bar and the % in the message; votes show right on the buttons. The message looks cleaner.
voting.weightsHint: The vote takes the HIGHEST weight among the voter's roles. E.g.: VIP = 3 → their vote counts 3x.

preview.label: Preview
preview.designHint: Drag the blocks to build the message. The bot fills in the fields (question/results) when publishing.
preview.classicHint: Classic Embed, turn on "Customize message" for a visual editor with images and layout.

classic.hidden: 🔒 Results hidden until the poll ends.
classic.footerCompact: preview · counts show on the buttons with the real votes
classic.footerBar: preview · numbers are examples, the bar grows with the real votes
